name: Aegiochusmon: Green
main_effect:
＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
＜Decode ([Aegiomon])＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 [Aegiomon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend until their turn ends. Then, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, this Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.) and +5000 DP for the turn.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
